items.title: Big four banks start move on rate hikes
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia has raised the cash rate to its highest level since 2008, with banks moving to pass on the pain to mortgage holders.

items.title: Dow surges 1,500 points after Democrats take control of Congress
items.summary: The prospect of political gridlock in Washington, D.C., will limit lawmakers' ability to pass sweeping tax and spending packages, according to Wall Street analysts.

items.title: CVS to split off drugstore business in major breakup of healthcare giant; shares fall 10%
items.summary: The move would reverse the company's $78 billion acquisition of Aetna and dismantle the vertically integrated healthcare conglomerate it created in 2018.

aus.headline: Big Banks Pass On Rate Hike
aus.body: The big four are passing the RBA's latest cash rate rise on to mortgage holders.
aus.why: Many Australian home loan borrowers now face higher costs.

us.headline: Dow Jumps 1,500 Points
us.body: US shares rallied hard after Democrats won control of Congress.
us.why: Analysts say gridlock may limit big US tax and spending plans.

biz.headline: CVS Splits Off Its Drugstores
biz.body: CVS plans to separate its drugstore arm, undoing its $78 billion Aetna deal of 2018.
biz.why: The breakup reshapes one of America's biggest healthcare groups.
